{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''slicer''' was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Elusive Prey}}</ref> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Elusive Prey" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> they were being tracked by a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (slicer)|bounty hunter]], who was offering payment for information on the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer's]] location.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the Cold War's two warring factions had a companion of theirs search for information on the slicer's whereabouts. The companion was able to give the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] a tip that resulted in the slicer's capture.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The slicer was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Elusive Prey" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
